title: Spicy

inlines.v: SPI'CY, adjective [from spice.] 1. Producing spice; abounding with spices; as the spicy shore of Arabia. 2. Having the qualities of spice; fragrant; aromatic; as spicy plants. Led by new stars and borne by spicy gales.
